terms.definition: The powerhouse organelle that releases usable energy from food.
terms.function: Breaks down food with oxygen to release energy in usable form.
terms.where: In the cytoplasm of almost all eukaryotic cells.

terms.definition: The process of breaking down food with oxygen to release energy.
terms.function: Supplies the cell with usable, spendable energy.
terms.why: It is how the body extracts energy from food.
terms.whyItMatters: It is how the body turns food into energy.

terms.definition: The folds of the inner membrane of the mitochondrion.
terms.function: Greatly increase the surface area of the inner membrane.
terms.why: More folds means more energy can be made faster.
terms.whyItMatters: More surface area means the cell can make energy faster.

terms.definition: Adenosine triphosphate - the 'energy coin' the cell spends to power its work.
terms.function: Carries usable energy to where the cell needs it.
terms.where: Produced in the mitochondrion, spent around the cell.
terms.why: It is the cell's universal energy currency.
terms.whereItIs: Made in the mitochondrion, used all around the cell.
